title: ぷっくり立体風のクリスマス
subject_en: Christmas objects in a cute puffy clay style, each a separate object with soft rounded forms. Every object has a closed, clearly darker edge tone all around; light parts (snow, cream, white fur trim) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white.
lead: ぷっくりした粘土のようなクリスマスの素材12点。ツリー、オーナメント、雪だるま、ジンジャークッキー、プレゼント、ベル。ちょっと立体感のあるカードやバナーに。
items: a puffy green Christmas tree with round red and gold ornaments and a star
a round red ornament ball with a gold cap and a small loop
a cream-coloured puffy snowman with a red scarf and a tiny hat
a red gift box with a gold ribbon bow
a gingerbread person cookie with icing dots and a smile
a gold bell with a red ribbon
a red Christmas stocking with cream fur trim
a small round green wreath with red berries and a bow (solid centre, no hole)
a cute round brown reindeer with a red nose and small antlers
a round strawberry shortcake with a tiny tree topper
